description.value:
Driven by endless curiosity, you have sharpened your talent for investigation and deduction to explore mysteries, find missing people, recover stolen goods, expose corruption and conspiracies, and solve crimes. You might have worked freelance, joined an inquisitive agency (perhaps one licensed by a dragonmarked house like Medani or Tharashk), reported for a broadsheet, or served in a police force.

Ability Scores: Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.feats24.Item.phbftAlert000000]{Alert}

Skill Proficiencies: Insight and Investigation

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulThievesToo]{Thieves' Tools}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulThievesToo]{Thieves' Tools}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagLanternBull]{Bullseye Lantern}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCrowbar0000]{Crowbar}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Oil} (10 flasks), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesTrav]{Traveler's Clothes}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP

SGNohbXhNV392cCo.title: Background Ability Score Improvement
SGNohbXhNV392cCo.hint: Your background allows you to increase your Constitution, Intelligence, and Charisma scores; increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.
